notes: role=library: the SDK provides the framework mechanisms (supports). Excluded framework features: broker-hosting (broker's concern, not the SDK) and rest-configuration (not implemented). mdns-discovery is provided via the optional `mdns` extra and the examples. The implements map reflects the examples/utility-meter reference publisher; its grid/status/demand/power-quality capabilities are defined inline in the utility-meter data model (covered by pinning utility-meter 0.3). If the simulators migrate out of examples/ into their own repo(s), each would carry its own application lockfile and this implements map would reduce to the SDK proper.
